start.text: The new defenses are in place. The malware is already spreading, like spilled ink.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! It is locking everything it reaches. It has three tricks: it spreads, it demands money, and it threatens to publish the copy.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A lock that spreads, a demand that grows, and a copy that is sent out. I counted three.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: That is what makes it dangerous.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: A [b][color=red]mass lock[/color][/b] that spreads one folder at a time, a [b][color=red]ransom demand[/color][/b] that grows until a wall comes, and [b][color=red]double extortion[/color][/b]: two copies, from both sides.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without that defense, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to weaken the threat. Cards that give [b][color=green]Dodge[/color][/b] make the next hits do nothing. When it attacks, you dodge. Keep going until it is [b][color=green]contained[/color][/b].
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. Let's stop it before it locks anything else.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
